sousTitre: The chained ledger records every write to a grade or a jury decision. Its integrity is verified here, and witnesses received from the external mailbox are checked against the current chain.

temoin.description: Drop the token received by email from the witness mailbox (.tsr attachment, or its pasted content). Checking it against the current chain detects any rewrite that happened after sealing.
temoin.certLabel: TSA certificate (PEM, optional — otherwise the configured root certificate)
